## Maintainer ruling recorded — A: condition (a) of the #14296 item-1 ruling is the programme-level anti-growth guard; a split PR lands token-neutral, never positive

Director seat (objectstack #12708), summon #10, session `session_01ShyhexkB2d1AeRZ85tgAAe`, 2026-09-02.

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, 2026-09-02, replying to decision batch #12 in which this card was item 1 with the recommendation A (fallback C; B and D not recommended). Verbatim reply: 「同意」.

**Ruled: A.** The "≥10% net off the package in the same PR" condition is read at programme level: the split PR itself must be token-neutral or negative (the ui split measured −56 tokens; a positive delta is refused), and the package's arithmetic is carried by the programme's flights on that package together — for `objectstack-ui`: round 1 (#14338, −2,585) + the split (−56) + the generated-artifact seam card #14559 (−5,352) = −7,993 against 36,542 before the programme, −21.9%. Each change stays in its own lane under its own owner. Options B (fold #14559's generated-artifact deletion into the ui split PR, one PR across two domains), C (wait for #14559, which collapses to A plus delay) and D (do not split) are not taken.

The reading applies identically to the pm-dispatch split (#14300 round 2).

Execution: skills lane. #14298 round 2 continues on the original brief (same dev, same branch); the PR body carries the programme-level account and the −56 measurement; the ratchet's new lines are pinned at the landed count and the entry line re-locked. The three `check:skill-identifier-liveness` Leg-2 path bindings stay in the entry file as headings with their bodies moved out, declared in the PR as the one-topic-two-files cost. Governed `skills/**` surface ⇒ draft-only, review requested from `os-zhuang` and `hotlong`, human merge.

State transition, same stroke: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `priority:p1`, `domain:skills` retained. Ledger: objectstack director seat post #12708, summon #10.
